title: A quick little summary of my VERY jam-packed trip to Gander.  My hear...
transcript: Here are all of the come from away themed locations that I visited while in Gander, Newfoundland. We flew into the Gander airport where the 38 planes were stranded. They don't have any proper gates, so you get to exit right onto the runway and see the iconic gander sign. Then of course, had to begin our trip at the Legion to get screeched in just like they did in the show. The next day we visited the Dover Fault where Nick and Diane fell in love. They also have a bench there dedicated in their honour and even recreated the photo that Nick took of Diane. Of course, we also had to go back to shoppers and visited the Gander Town Hall where we saw the suggestion box where people left money, as well as the town council chambers where I got to sit in the mayor's chair. They also had a collection of letters that people had sent into the town to thank them for their generosity and hospitality during this time. Throughout the trip, we actually saw three different pieces of steel from the World Trade Center, one of which was at Gander Town Hall, one in Appleton, and one at the airport. We drove by Gander Academy and Gander Collegiate and visited the ice rink that became the world's largest walk in refrigerator. And finally we visited Bonnie at the SPCAand meet some of the animals living there.
classificationReason: A tourism vlog of Come From Away–related locations in Gander, Newfoundland (airport, Legion, Dover Fault, etc.). Come From Away is not on the list, and no opinion about any listed stage production is offered.
